question: How are monthly scaffolding permit fees calculated when construction scaffolding occupies public roadways?
answer: The monthly scaffolding permit fees for construction scaffolding that occupies public roadways are calculated based on the length of the scaffolding. For scaffolding up to 10 meters in length, the fee is PHP 150. For every lineal meter or fraction thereof in excess of 10 meters, an additional PHP 12 is charged. [S2]
